title: China's Local Government Debt, Strategic Competition, and Bitcoin Demand: A Conditional Transmission Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.18767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How might the resolution of China's local-government debt affect strategic competition and Bitcoin demand? This paper develops a conditional framework connecting debt accounting, bank balance-sheet adjustment, public spending priorities, and constrained portfolio substitution. A debt swap can increase recognized government debt without increasing consolidated principal, while its effect on credit capacity depends on capital relief, loss recognition, and recapitalization. A protected strategic-spending floor can preserve current effort while shifting adjustment toward civilian productive services. In the asset block, stronger relative preference for Bitcoin does not ensure greater effective demand: access constraints and global funding conditions can reverse the sign. We derive a finite-shock threshold and deterministic sign bounds, and distinguish Bitcoin demand from demand for dollar stablecoins. Reproducible numerical illustrations and

translated_title: 中国地方政府债务、战略竞争与比特币需求：一个条件性传导框架
translated_abstract: 中国地方政府债务的化解可能如何影响战略竞争与比特币需求？本文构建了一个条件性框架，将债务核算、银行资产负债表调整、公共支出优先级以及受约束的资产组合替代联系起来。债务置换可以在不增加合并本金的情况下增加确认的政府债务，而其对信贷能力的影响取决于资本缓释、损失确认与再注资。受保护的战略性支出下限可以在维持当前努力的同时，将调整压力转移至民用生产性服务部门。在资产模块中，对比特币更强的相对偏好并不必然带来更大的有效需求：准入约束与全球融资条件可能使符号发生逆转。我们推导了有限冲击阈值与确定性的符号界限，并区分了比特币需求与对美元稳定币的需求。可复现的数值示例与……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个条件性传导框架，揭示中国地方政府债务置换对信贷能力的影响取决于资本缓释、损失确认与再注资等条件，且对比特币的更强偏好并不必然转化为更大的有效需求，准入约束与全球融资条件可能逆转其作用方向。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a conditional transmission framework showing that China's local government debt swaps affect credit capacity only depending on capital relief, loss recognition, and recapitalization, and that a stronger preference for Bitcoin does not guarantee greater effective demand, as access constraints and global funding conditions can reverse the sign.
